name: Pronamic Pay doneren met Mollie
author: Pronamic

sections.description:
Pronamic Pay · Pronamic · GitHub

Looking for a modern successor to the “Doneren met Mollie” plugin by wobbie.nl / Nick Dijkstra? Look no further. The “Pronamic Pay doneren met Mollie” plugin is the new, modern solution for accepting donations with Mollie. It is built entirely with the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg), giving you complete flexibility and control. You can easily customize your donation forms using standard WordPress blocks like groups, rows, and columns. Add unlimited fields, adjust the layout to match your design, and create responsive donation forms that fit seamlessly into your website without writing any code.

Features

This plugin is developed from the idea that online payments should be easy. Some of the features:

  • Easy install
  • Support for most major payment methods
  • Payment status pages
  • Automatic payment status updates via Mollie webhooks and the WordPress REST API
  • High quality support
  • Built by Pronamic

External services

This plugin uses a number of external services to initiate payments. These are documented below with a link to the service’s Terms of Use.

Mollie API

This plugin provides the link between WordPress and payment provider Mollie. To communicate with Mollie, this plugin connects to the Mollie API via https://api.mollie.com/. The documentation for the Mollie API can be found at https://docs.mollie.com/, Mollie’s user agreement can be found at https://www.mollie.com/user-agreement. From your WordPress website, customer and payment data can be passed on to Mollie for setting up and processing payments.

  • Pronamic
sections.installation:
1. To install this plugin you can follow the WordPress documentation section “Installing Plugins“.
  2. After installation you can follow the manual “How to connect Mollie to WordPress with Pronamic Pay“.

Composer

  • Changed automattic/jetpack-autoloader from v5.0.23 to v6.0.3. Jetpack Autoloader 6 only raises its minimum PHP version to 7.4. Version 6.0.3 hardens path handling.

    Release notes: https://github.com/jsonrainbow/json-schema/releases/tag/6.0.0
    Release notes: https://github.com/jsonrainbow/json-schema/releases/tag/6.14.0
  • Added marc-mabe/php-enum v4.7.2. New dependency of justinrainbow/json-schema 6.
    Release notes: https://github.com/marc-mabe/php-enum/releases/tag/v4.7.2
  • Changed pronamic/wp-pronamic-forms from v2.1.1 to v2.1.2. Allowed Jetpack Autoloader 6.x.
    Release notes: https://github.com/pronamic/pronamic-forms/releases/tag/v2.1.2
  • Changed wp-pay-gateways/mollie from v4.21.0 to v4.22.0. Allowed Jetpack Autoloader 6.x and now requires justinrainbow/json-schema ^6.8.

Full set of changes: 1.7.1...1.8.0

1.7.1 – 2026-11-02

Security

  • Form submissions can no longer be read through the REST API by users who cannot edit submissions (via pronamic/wp-pronamic-forms v2.1.1).

Changed

  • New form submissions are stored as private posts, and the submission post type is explicitly non-public (via pronamic/wp-pronamic-forms v2.1.1).
  • Updated build and development dependencies.

Composer

  • Changed giggsey/libphonenumber-for-php-lite from 9.0.40 to 9.0.42.
    Updates phone number metadata for many regions and fixes Brazilian dialling without a carrier code.
    Release notes: https://github.com/giggsey/libphonenumber-for-php-lite/releases/tag/9.0.41, https://github.com/giggsey/libphonenumber-for-php-lite/releases/tag/9.0.42
  • Changed pronamic/wp-pronamic-forms from v2.1.0 to v2.1.1.
    Restricts the submissions REST API endpoints to users who can edit submissions, stores new submissions as private and lets WordPress load the translations automatically.
    Release notes: https://github.com/pronamic/pronamic-forms/releases/tag/v2.1.1
  • Changed symfony/polyfill-mbstring from v1.38.2 to v1.43.3.
    Fixes endless loops in mb_convert_case() and mb_encode_numericentity(), adds argument validation to mb_ord() and mb_chr(), and rejects code points above U+10FFFF in mb_check_encoding().
    Release notes: https://github.com/symfony/polyfill-mbstring/releases/tag/v1.43.3

Full set of changes: 1.7.0...1.7.1

1.7.0 – 2026-09-28

Changed

  • Raised the minimum required PHP version from 8.2 to 8.3.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1.
  • Donation form email fields can now pass the donor’s email address to the Mollie payment, and payment descriptions now read “Form submission {entry ID}” (via pronamic/wp-pronamic-forms v2.1.0).
  • The default subscription renewal pre-notification period changed from 1 week to 14 days (via wp-pay/core v4.35.0).

Composer

  • Changed automattic/jetpack-autoloader from v5.0.21 to v5.0.23.
    Fixes and then reverts applying the root package’s exclude-from-classmap setting when generating the Jetpack class map.
    Release notes: https://github.com/Automattic/jetpack-autoloader/blob/v5.0.23/CHANGELOG.md
  • Changed pronamic/wp-mollie from v1.10.1 to v2.0.0.
    Breaking change: the due_date property moved from PaymentRequest to BankTransferPaymentRequest, because Mollie only supports due dates for bank transfer payments.
    Release notes: https://github.com/pronamic/wp-mollie/releases/tag/v2.0.0
  • Changed pronamic/wp-money from 2.4.5 to 2.5.0.
    Adds an optional currency argument to Parser::parse(), so amounts can be parsed in currencies other than EUR.
    Release notes: https://github.com/pronamic/wp-money/releases/tag/v2.5.0
  • Changed pronamic/wp-pronamic-forms from v2.0.1 to v2.1.0.
    Adds support for passing the submitter’s email address to Pronamic Pay through the pronamic_payment_customer_email field reference, and makes payment descriptions translatable.
    Release notes: https://github.com/pronamic/pronamic-forms/releases/tag/v2.1.0
  • Changed woocommerce/action-scheduler from 4.0.0 to 4.2.0.
    Fixes a lock that could get permanently stuck, enforces unique action inserts atomically, reduces SQL queries on the admin page and hardens schedule data deserialization.
    Release notes: https://github.com/woocommerce/action-scheduler/releases/tag/4.1.0, https://github.com/woocommerce/action-scheduler/releases/tag/4.2.0
  • Changed wp-pay-gateways/mollie from v4.20.0 to v4.21.0.
    Uses a bank transfer payment request when setting the Mollie payment due date, and moves to pronamic/wp-mollie ^2.0.
    Release notes: https://github.com/pronamic/wp-pronamic-pay-mollie/releases/tag/v4.21.0
  • Changed wp-pay/core from v4.34.0 to v4.35.0.
    Changes the default subscription renewal pre-notification period to 14 days and fixes a currency mismatch exception with non-EUR payment lines, errors for payments and subscriptions whose post no longer exists, and PHP deprecation notices.
    Release notes: https://github.com/pronamic/wp-pay-core/releases/tag/v4.35.0

Full set of changes: 1.6.0...1.7.0

1.6.0 – 2026-08-03

Added

Composer

  • Added pronamic/pronamic-pay-default-payment-methods v1.1.0.
    Provides centralized default payment method registration, including new online banking methods for Czechia and Slovakia.
    Release notes: https://github.com/pronamic/pronamic-pay-default-payment-methods/releases/tag/v1.1.0
  • Changed woocommerce/action-scheduler from v3.9.3 to v4.0.0.
    Major release with breaking changes: unique-action scheduling now considers action arguments and failed actions are automatically purged after three months.
    Release notes: https://github.com/woocommerce/action-scheduler/releases/tag/4.0.0
  • Changed wp-pay-gateways/mollie from v4.19.0 to v4.20.0.
    Defers Mollie webhook processing with Action Scheduler and fixes timezone handling for due date calculation.
    Release notes: https://github.com/pronamic/wp-pronamic-pay-mollie/releases/tag/v4.20.0
  • Changed wp-pay/core from v4.32.0 to v4.34.0.
    Moves default payment method registration into a dedicated package via the new pronamic_pay_register_payment_methods action and allows Action Scheduler ^4.0.
    Release notes: https://github.com/pronamic/wp-pay-core/releases/tag/v4.34.0
